name: gst
description: Study how a game you own is made through reverse engineering: engine recon, decompilation, asset and format extraction, runtime observation, rendering analysis and an ARCHITECTURE.md report. Driven by the gst CLI; offline, local-only, never bypasses anti-cheat or DRM.

gs_home.title: Study root (GS_HOME)
gs_home.description: Folder where per-game study workspaces live. Must be outside any git repository.
